observed: Windows installer background process ended after the llama.cpp git checkout entry. Shared progress.json still had Finished=false and no final error. User saw a generic failure and lost the log view.
changes: Keep the same live log control visible on the result page until explicitly closed; add full-log button.
Redirect background stdout/stderr to private per-run files and keep their paths plus PID in last-operation.json.
Require an explicit final success status AND zero process exit. Report unexpected termination with decimal/hex exit code, last phase and available output.
Record external command and PID; native failures include last 15 program output lines. Linux failures include stage, command and traceback in installation-error.json.
Persist successful per-file model verification on Windows and WSL, keyed by path, size, timestamps/change metadata and expected checksum.
Check copies independently, preserve proof across validated rename and installer-owned ownership changes, invalidate stale/failed proofs and offer explicit full recheck.
limits: 1.3 has no per-file fingerprints; one full verification is needed on first 1.4 run.
No claim that the unknown original abort trigger is fixed.
Windows cache uses path, size, last-write and creation timestamps; WSL also checks device, inode and ctime.
